issue_context.title: NWS integration: Missing condition constant
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

No weather icon is shown when condition is "Snow/sleet".  This should likely be added to `ATTR_CONDITION_SNOWY` in `core/homeassistant/components/nws/const.py`.


**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

core-2021.1.4

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

_No response_

**What type of installation are you running?**

Home Assistant Core

**Integration causing the issue**

National Weather Service (NWS)

**Link to integration documentation on our website**

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nws/

**Example YAML snippet**

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line

```


**Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?**

```txt
# snippet from "weather.kcho_hourly"
temperature: 30
humidity: 86
pressure: 30.24
wind_bearing: 40
wind_speed: 9
visibility: 1
attribution: Data from National Weather Service/NOAA
forecast:
  - detailed_description: ''
    temperature: 30
    datetime: '2021-02-13T12:00:00-05:00'
    condition: Snow/sleet
    precipitation_probability: 100
    wind_bearing: 45
    wind_speed: 7
```
comments:
Hey there @matthewflamm, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`nws`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L320) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Indeed.  This is missing.  Here is a list of conditions that can be supplied by the upstream library, if there are any other missing

https://github.com/MatthewFlamm/pynws/blob/f6d706b7d36c44e076831c3f46d003d7835b6a85/pynws/const.py#L26

Even more ideal if they were constants from upstream library
